title: The Fundamental Law of 2011
grammar: Recap: attributing a judgement with szerint
goal: I can describe how the Fundamental Law was adopted in 2011, with the dates and the source of each view (*Alaptörvény, Nemzeti Hitvallás, sarkalatos törvény*).

sections.title: Unit 25: The Fundamental Law and the Constitutional Court, 2010–2026
body: Between 2010 and 2026 Hungary adopted a new constitution, the Fundamental Law (*Alaptörvény*, 2011), changed the powers of the Constitutional Court and declared a state of danger (*veszélyhelyzet*) several times. Each step was welcomed by some and criticised by others, in Hungary and abroad.

In five short accounts you follow these events year by year, name who judged them how, and practise the forms a neutral history needs: attribution, obligation in the past, proportion, degrees of certainty and contrast. The period ends with the parliamentary election of 12 April 2026.
